audience: People who have heard of Tau Net or hold AGRS and want to see what the testnet really does; then anyone curious about a blockchain with rules in logic.
question: What is the Tau Net testnet?
title: What is the Tau Net testnet? Watch it work, live

scenes.say: This is a blockchain whose rules are written in logic, and the people using it can change them. It is live right now. Here is what that looks like.
scenes.caption: Tau Testnet Alpha, live

scenes.say: This is Tau Testnet Alpha, the test network of Tau Net. Block after block is sealed while you watch. Nothing here is a recording. You are looking through our own node.
scenes.caption: Seen from our own node

scenes.say: Each line is a real transaction on the test network. A payment is simple here: from, to, amount. No memo, no message.
scenes.caption: From, to, amount

scenes.say: Here is what makes it different. A wallet can give itself a rule, written in the Tau language. Pay only these people. Never more than this amount. The chain itself holds the wallet to it.
scenes.caption: Rules wallets gave themselves

scenes.say: And this is the moment that matters. A payment that breaks a rule is refused by the chain itself. Not by a company, not by a support desk. By the rule.
scenes.caption: The chain says no

scenes.say: The chain's own rules work the same way. They are a Tau program too, and they change only when the validators agree, on the chain, in the open.
scenes.caption: The chain's own rule

scenes.say: It is an alpha. Test coins have no value, things break, and when they do, it shows here.
scenes.caption: Health and incidents, in the open

scenes.say: Want to try it? A new wallet gets 100,000 test coins once, free. Next: how to follow every block yourself.
scenes.caption: Four first steps

description: Tau Net is a blockchain whose rules are written in the Tau language and changed by agreement. This video shows its test network, Tau Testnet Alpha, at work: real blocks, real transactions, and the moment a rule refuses a payment.

facts.faucet: a new account receives 100,000 test tokens on its first transaction (tauhud.com/facts/, fact 'faucet')
facts.transfer: a transfer is three values: from, to, amount; there is no memo field (fact 'transfer')
facts.alpha: the testnet is alpha, its tokens have no real value (fact 'alpha')
facts.governance: consensus rules change only through governance on the chain (fact 'governance')
